text:
Hana Lee: Hey folks, day 1 question: what's the short practical guide for where to post common things (laptop issues, API keys, product questions, quick status notes)? And how do you silence noisy bots without missing pager-level alerts?

Connor V.: Welcome Hana! Quick map: laptop/access -> #help (use template), infra/deploy -> #eng-infra, product/context -> #product, team updates -> your team channel (reply in thread for back-and-forth).

Priya S.: Template we use in #help:
Name / Team / What I need / Error snippet (if any) / Urgency (low|med|high). Paste exact command output for infra tickets.

Hana Lee: Nice. And the bot thing? Deploy notifications are relentless.

OpsBot: To reduce noise: channel > View apps > select the bot > set "only notify on failures". Alternatively subscribe to the onboarding digest (DM) instead of channel posts. Never mute #eng-oncall or the @oncall role.

Connor V.: Also set personal notification keywords (your name, "pager") so mobile only buzzes on important alerts. Use reactions for ack (thumbsup) instead of reply when no follow-up is needed.

OnboardBot: Hi Hana! To get a buddy reply "buddy please" or run `/onboard assign-buddy`. Onboarding docs: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding/slack-quickstart.

Hana Lee: Thanks — I'll post access requests to #help and infra errors to #eng-infra. Buddy please if anyone volunteers!
